title: Ricardo and the Gold Miners
description: Ever thought gold was safe in the Nether? Think again.
body:
Ever thought gold was safe in the Nether? Think again. Piglins now steal gold — from the ground, your inventory, and even strip it off you if you're wearing gold armor. They also mine gold now. Say hi to Ricardo the Golem.

This update also works on servers now.
Spiders shoot webs; Cave spiders inflict deadly venom lasting an entire in-game day — cure it with an antidote syringe.
Creepers explode instantly on damage or if you get too close. Gunpowder must now be crafted using new ores: sulfur and sulfite.
Pillagers are a bit stronger now. ;)
